newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Seven killed in southern Philippine road accident.
newsitem.headline: Seven killed in southern Philippine road accident.

text.p: Seven people died, including a nine-year-old girl, and four were injured when a mini-bus collided head-on with a cargo truck in the southern Philippines, police said on Monday.
The collision happened on Sunday evening along a national highway just outside Zamboanga city, 870 km (540 miles) south of Manila.
The victims were on their way to attend a wake in a neighbouring town when the accident occurred. All the dead and injured were from the bus.
The truck driver said he swerved to the opposite lane while trying to avoid a bicycle cart.
